name: opdshelf-assets
description: Front-end assets for OPDShelf (the server itself is written in Rust)

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:vendor
scripts.build:vendor: mkdir -p static/vendor/fontawesome static/vendor/epubjs static/vendor/pdfjs && cp -r node_modules/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/css node_modules/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/webfonts static/vendor/fontawesome/ && cp node_modules/epubjs/dist/epub.min.js node_modules/jszip/dist/jszip.min.js static/vendor/epubjs/ && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.min.mjs node_modules/pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs static/vendor/pdfjs/
